title: Philippines will allow use of dirtier, cheaper fuel amid US-Iran war | South China Morning Post
summary: The Philippines temporarily permits the use of a cheaper, dirtier fuel type to cope with the Middle East crisis's impact on fuel supply. This measure affects specific sectors like model-year 2015 and earlier vehicles, jeepneys, power plants, generators, marine, and shipping industries. Additionally, there's a protest due to a surge in local diesel prices following a rise in global oil prices.
sentiment_reason: The decision to allow a cheaper, dirtier fuel type and the subsequent protest due to rising diesel prices indicate negative market impacts, reflecting concerns over environmental standards and cost implications.
